items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: His, uh, his wife's maiden name was Milto, I think. I think her maiden name was, was Milto.

ctx.x: I've often wondered why Fisher changed his name like that.

I don't know. I, my mother doesn't even know. Because we, we, you know, my mother knows his, his wife real well. Uh-huh. The fact is, they lived right around the corner from us when we lived down, down there on Bell Castle Street. And, uh, why, he ever changed his name or not? His, uh, his wife's maiden name was Milto, I think. I think her maiden name was, was Milto.
